changelog:
- Orientation Snapping Fixed: Fullscreen custom view no longer forces sensor landscape rotation.
- Play/Pause Twitch Loop Fixed: Removed polling watchdog and button toggle collisions; playback automation is clean, smooth, and respects user pause.
- Lockscreen Media Controls & MediaSession: Lockscreen card and notification with Play/Pause, Skip ±10s, and track title.
- Screen-Off Audio Playback: Audio continues playing when the screen is locked or turned off with CPU wake lock.
- 1-Tap Burn Session: Instantly purge all cookies, site data, cache, and open tabs with a single tap.
- Geo-Unblocker Headers: Automatic X-Forwarded-For & Client-IP header injection to bypass location blocks without a system VPN.
